# Docus

Nuxt layer for docs built on Nuxt Content (MDC Markdown in `content/`) and Nuxt UI (prose components). Generic Nuxt Content handling (`_payload.json`, `routeRules`, `/_ipx/` images): `mint migrate --from nuxt`. This guide covers the Docus repo layout and the Nuxt UI component syntax.

## Detect

- `docus` in `package.json` dependencies; `nuxt.config.ts` with `extends: ['docus']`, or scripts running `nuxt dev --extends docus` with no config file.
- `content/` with numeric-prefixed names (`1.getting-started/2.installation.md`) and `.navigation.yml` files.
- `@nuxt-themes/docus` instead means the old Docus (Nuxt Content 2, `_dir.yml`, different components). Its syntax is not covered here: follow `mint migrate --from nuxt`, flag every unmapped component and report.
- A `docus` dependency wins over the generic Nuxt signals.

## Get the source

### From the repo

Reference: https://docus.dev/en/getting-started/project-structure

- Root is the folder whose `package.json` depends on `docus` (often `docs/` in a monorepo).
- Pages: `content/**/*.md`. `content/index.md` is the landing page.
- `content/docs/` present: documentation lives there and is served under `/docs/...`; other files beside it are separate site pages: ask the user whether to migrate them.
- i18n: one folder per locale code (`content/en/`, `content/fr/`), each with its own `index.md`.
- Read `app.config.ts` (or `app/app.config.ts`), `nuxt.config.ts`, `content.config.ts` if present (extra collections such as a blog or changelog: see `mint migrate --topic changelog`), and `app/components/content/*.vue` (custom MDC components).
- `app/pages/*.vue` are Vue routes, not content: list them and report.

### From an export

None; the site is built from the repo.

### From the live site

`_payload.json` extraction: (`mint migrate --from nuxt`, From the live site).

## Config → docs.json

Reference: https://docus.dev/en/concepts/configuration

| Docus                                                                                                                                                                                            | docs.json                                                                            |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `seo.title`, else `site.name` in `nuxt.config.ts`, else `package.json` `name`                                                                                                                    | `name`                                                                               |
| `seo.description`, else `package.json` `description`                                                                                                                                             | `description`                                                                        |
| `header.logo.light` / `header.logo.dark`                                                                                                                                                         | `logo.light` / `logo.dark` (by key; Docus file names are often inverted)             |
| `header.logo.display: 'wordmark'`                                                                                                                                                                | `logo` from `header.logo.wordmark.light` / `.dark`                                   |
| `header.logo.favicon`, else `public/favicon.ico`                                                                                                                                                 | `favicon`                                                                            |
| `ui.colors.primary` (Tailwind color name; unset means the Nuxt UI default)                                                                                                                       | `colors.primary`: read `--ui-primary` from the live site's CSS and resolve it to hex |
| `docus.colorMode: 'light'` / `'dark'`                                                                                                                                                            | `appearance.default` + `appearance.strict: true`                                     |
| `socials` (Simple Icons key → URL, shown in the footer)                                                                                                                                          | `footer.socials` for keys Mintlify supports; others: drop and report                 |
| `github.url` (or the git remote when `github` is unset)                                                                                                                                          | `navbar.links` entry with `type: "github"`, only if the header showed it             |
| `navigation.sub: 'header'`                                                                                                                                                                       | `navigation.tabs`, one per top-level folder                                          |
| `navigation.sub: 'aside'`                                                                                                                                                                        | `navigation.anchors`, one per top-level folder                                       |
| `nuxt.config.ts` `i18n.locales`, `defaultLocale`                                                                                                                                                 | `navigation.languages`, `default: true` on the default                               |
| `nuxt.config.ts` `routeRules` redirects                                                                                                                                                          | `redirects` (see `mint migrate --from nuxt`)                                         |
| `github.branch` / `rootDir` (edit and issue links), `toc.title`, `toc.bottom`, `search`, `seo.titleTemplate`, `seo.schema`, `docus.locale`, `docus.shortcuts`, other `ui.*`, `app/app.css` theme | drop and report                                                                      |
| `assistant`, `mcp`, `llms` settings                                                                                                                                                              | drop and report                                                                      |

## Navigation

References: https://content.nuxt.com/docs/collections/types#ordering-files, https://content.nuxt.com/docs/utils/query-collection-navigation

- The sidebar is the `content/` tree (or `content/docs/`, or `content/<locale>/`). Each folder → a group; files and subfolders → its pages and nested groups.
- Order: siblings sort alphabetically by their full prefixed name, so `10.faq` comes before `2.setup` unless padded (`02.`). Reproduce that exact order; confirm against the live sidebar.
- Group label and icon: the folder's `.navigation.yml` `title`, and `icon` (top-level or under `navigation:`). No `.navigation.yml`: copy the label the live sidebar shows.
- Folder `index.md` → first page of its group.
- Page frontmatter `navigation: false`: not in the sidebar (`mint migrate --topic navigation`, Structure rules). `navigation.title` → `sidebarTitle`; `navigation.icon` → `icon`.
- Icons are Iconify names (`mint migrate --topic conversion`, Icons).
- With `navigation.sub` set, each top-level folder becomes a tab or anchor holding that folder's groups.

## Content conversion

Syntax references: https://content.nuxt.com/docs/files/markdown, https://ui.nuxt.com/docs/typography

MDC structure:

- Block: `::name{key="value" flag}` ... `::`. Nested blocks add a colon (`:::tabs-item` inside `::tabs`), and each closer has its opener's colon count.
- Props: inline `{...}`, or a YAML block between `---` lines right after the opener. `:prop='json'` binds a value. Props are data: never emit them as text.
- Slots: `#name` lines inside a block (`#title`, `#description`, `#default`, `#code`).
- Inline: `:name{props}`. Spans `[text]{.class #id style="..."}` → `text`. Attributes on inline code (`` `x`{lang="ts"} ``) → `` `x` ``.

`::note`, `::tip`, `::warning`: `mint migrate --topic conversion`, Admonitions.

| Docus / Nuxt UI                                                   | Mintlify                                                                                              |
| ----------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `::caution`                                                       | `<Danger>`                                                                                            |
| `::callout{color="info"}` / `"warning"` / `"error"` / `"success"` | `<Info>` / `<Warning>` / `<Danger>` / `<Check>`                                                       |
| `::callout` with `neutral`, `primary`, `secondary` or no color    | `<Callout icon="...">` with a Font Awesome icon, else `<Note>`                                        |
| callout `to` / `target`                                           | add the link to the callout text; report                                                              |
| `::tabs` + `:::tabs-item{label icon}`                             | `<Tabs>` + `<Tab title icon>`; drop `sync`, `hash`, `defaultValue`                                    |
| `::code-group` of `[label]` fences                                | `<CodeGroup>`, label → fence title; drop `sync`                                                       |
| `::code-tree{default-value}`                                      | `<CodeGroup>`, each fence titled with its path; report the tree view                                  |
| `::code-collapse` around a fence                                  | the fence with `expandable`                                                                           |
| `::code-preview` (default slot + `#code`)                         | the rendered content, then the `#code` fence; report                                                  |
| `::steps{level="N"}` (default level 3)                            | `<Steps>`; each heading of that level → `<Step title>`, content up to the next one as body            |
| `::card-group`                                                    | `<Columns cols={2}>`                                                                                  |
| `::card{title icon to target color}`                              | `<Card title icon href>`; drop `color`, `target`                                                      |
| `::accordion` + `:::accordion-item{label icon}`                   | `<AccordionGroup>` + `<Accordion title icon>`                                                         |
| `::collapsible{name}`                                             | `<Accordion title>` with the trigger label shown on the live site                                     |
| `::field-group` + `::field{name type required description}`       | `<ResponseField name type required>` per field, `description` or slot as body; drop the group wrapper |
| `::badge`                                                         | `<Badge>`                                                                                             |
| `:icon{name}`                                                     | `<Icon icon>` (`mint migrate --topic conversion`, Icons)                                              |
| `:kbd{value}`                                                     | `<kbd>value</kbd>`                                                                                    |
| `:video{src autoplay controls loop}`                              | `<video src controls autoPlay loop>`                                                                  |
| `u-page-*` and other `u-*` Nuxt UI components (landing page)      | headings, paragraphs and `<Card>`s from their props and slots; report                                 |
| custom `app/components/content/*.vue`                             | `mint migrate --topic conversion`, Components                                                         |

Code fences:

| Docus                                    | Mintlify                                                             |
| ---------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| ` ```ts [nuxt.config.ts] `               | ` ```ts nuxt.config.ts ` (`title="..."` if the label has spaces)     |
| ` ```ts [file.ts] {2,4-5} `              | ` ```ts file.ts highlight={2,4-5} `                                  |
| ` ```diff [file.ts] ` with `+`/`-` lines | the file's language; strip prefixes, add `[!code ++]` / `[!code --]` |

Frontmatter (https://docus.dev/en/concepts/edition):

- `title` → `title`. If missing, Nuxt Content took the first `# H1`: move it into `title`.
- `description` renders under the title: keep it.
- `navigation` → see Navigation. `seo.title` / `seo.description` override meta only: drop and report.
- `layout`, `links`, `sitemap`, other keys → drop and report.
- `content/index.md` (landing) → `mode: "custom"`; leave it out of the sidebar groups.

## Assets

- `public/` is served at the site root; Docus pages reference it root-absolute (`mint migrate --topic conversion`, Images and files).
- Images under `app/assets/` or referenced from Vue components: same handling.
- Logo and favicon paths in `app.config.ts` are `public/` paths.

## URLs and redirects

- Path = file path under `content/` minus extension, numeric `N.` prefixes stripped from every segment, `index` dropped: `content/1.guide/2.installation.md` → `/guide/installation`. Rename files without prefixes to keep those paths.
- With `content/docs/`, every doc path starts with `/docs/`: keep a `docs/` folder in Mintlify.
- i18n forces a prefix on every locale, the default included (`/en/guide/...`), and `/` redirects to the default locale. Keep `en/`, `fr/` folders. Regional codes appear lowercase in URLs (`zh-TW` → `/zh-tw/`): name the folder in lowercase. Ask the user how `/` should resolve.
- A locale listed in `nuxt.config.ts` without a `content/<code>/` folder was never published: skip it.
- `nuxt.config.ts` `routeRules` redirects: see `mint migrate --from nuxt`.

## Known gaps

Report each: Docus AI assistant, MCP server and `llms.txt` settings; Studio; `code-tree` file browser and `code-preview` live rendering; callout links and colors; card colors; Iconify icons with no Font Awesome match; landing-page `u-page-*` layout; custom Vue components and `app/pages/*.vue` routes; `navigation.sub` behavior beyond tabs or anchors; `toc.bottom` links; theme CSS and `ui.*` overrides; old Docus (`@nuxt-themes/docus`) components.
